audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart was wrong in both layers: the page read Vladimir / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Vladimir while the packet and the already-audited mirror both give Volibear / Vladimir / Vladimir / Volibear / Volibear / Vladimir / Volibear. The content whys already described the packet's swing on rows 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, so the win[] tokens disagreed with their own explanations on all seven rows.
audit.why: The swing is driven by real cooldowns: you take level 1 on passive attack speed against a thin Transfusion, he takes 2-3 once Transfusion (9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6s) heals through pokes and Sanguine Pool (28/25/22/19/16s) removes him from your burst for 2s, you retake 4-6 as a bruiser against a still-weak AP profile with Stormbringer online, he takes first item as AP turns Transfusion and Tides of Blood into real poke, and you retake 2+ items as the diver who can end it before Hemoplague fights.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet sides in both layers as one atomic group, ratings moved with them, and phases[1]/[2]/[5].why rewritten so they no longer promise a Volibear kill window on rows Vladimir takes.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why sold Sundered Sky as owning the first-item stage, and gave no reason the stage is actually contested.
audit.why: Vladimir's first AP item scales both halves of his kit through Crimson Pact (AP converts to health and back), so his poke and his sustain spike together. Sustain-through-damage does not answer that — Grievous Wounds and MR do, which is what report[8] already recommends (Executioner's Calling, Mercury's Treads, Spirit Visage).
audit.corrected: phases[5].why now names the AP spike on Transfusion and Tides of Blood and points at anti-heal and MR instead of Sundered Sky.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and wants.you[2] both credit Volibear's E with a stun, and neither gives Sanguine Pool's duration or cooldown — the two numbers the whole matchup runs on.
audit.why: Thundering Smash (Q, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) is the stun and it is an auto-attack reset: the stun resolves on the next attack, which is exactly the tell Vladimir pools on. Sky Splitter (E, 16s) damages, slows and shields Volibear only if he stands in the blast radius — it has no stun. Sanguine Pool is 2s of untargetability on a 28/25/22/19/16s cooldown, so a burst spent into it is refunded to him entirely.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the Q stun and carries Pool's 2s untargetable window; wants.you[2] changed from 'Stun with E' to 'Stun with Q'; phases[2].why states the 28s rank-1 Pool cooldown and the stand-in-the-blast condition on the shield.

edits.before: Q + W online — stun in, double-bite out. Vladimir has to respect every walk-up once your second W heal-bite threatens.
edits.after: Q + W online, but Transfusion (9s at rank 1) heals back what a two-bite trade takes — you cannot out-poke him at this stage.

edits.before: E completes the pattern: shield yourself as you disengage or slow Vladimir under the sky-splitter. This is the start of your kill window.
edits.after: Sanguine Pool (28s at rank 1) makes him untargetable for 2s and eats your whole burst — Sky Splitter shields you only if you stand in the blast.

edits.before: Sundered Sky doubles down on the all-in: crit-heal on the first hit of every fight. Force Vladimir to fight or lose the wave.
edits.after: His first AP item turns Transfusion and Tides of Blood into real poke — Executioner's Calling and MR hold this stage, not Sundered Sky.

edits.before: Stormbringer lets you all-in over his poke, but he can Sanguine Pool your E stun cast — bait Pool first, then engage.
edits.after: Stormbringer lets you all-in over his poke, but Sanguine Pool (2s untargetable) eats your Q stun — bait Pool first, then engage.

edits.before: Stun with E after baiting his Pool
edits.after: Stun with Q after baiting his Pool

notes: All seven chart rows were desynced from the packet and from their own why text — this is the two-answers-on-one-page bug in its worst form here, and both layers are now proposed together. Same ability-identity error as the vayne page: Volibear's E was credited with a stun in spikes[1].text and wants.you[2]. Sky Splitter slows, damages and shields him when he stands in the blast; Thundering Smash is the stun and it resolves on his next attack, which is precisely the animation Vladimir pools on.
